title: Investigation of the effectiveness of an interaction-based parent-child treatment concept in an inpatient child and adolescent psychiatric setting
summary: For the study, all patients and their parents will be informed about the study during the clarification discussion before the start of treatment and asked to participate. Four examination points are planned for the data collection (T0: clarification discussion; T1: at the time of inpatient admission; T2: 4 weeks after inpatient admission as part of inpatient treatment; T3: follow-up 6 months after T2).

interventions.name: Exploratory longitudinal study with a consecutively collected clinical sample. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Patients on the parent-child ward, consent to participate in the study, sufficient knowledge of German on the part of the caregivers
Exclusion criteria:
No consent to participate in the study; insufficient German language skills of the caregivers
